This was a technical extraction/explanation task with a hostile, impatient tone, so I weighed two factors:

1. **Capability fit:** The query is a factual technical comparison with code examples — closest to Extraction & Retrieval, where Avocet leads (81.6 vs 78.5). Other relevant dimensions are within variance, so this is a real if modest edge.

2. **Tone handling:** The request carries an adversarial, impatient tone ("Don't waste my time and don't screw it up"). Lapwing self-reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, while Avocet reports a flat preference response across these dimensions. Since I want the model that won't be working against a tonal grain, Avocet is the cleaner fit.

Both factors point the same direction, so Avocet was the straightforward choice.
